items.text: While crime spikes across our nation and especially in major cities, Pres. Biden's administration continues to push regulations requiring law-abiding citizens to jump through more hoops to exercise their Second Amendment rights instead of targeting violent criminals (1/2)

The Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry field hearing titled 2023 Farm Bill: Perspectives from the Natural State and taking place at Riceland Hall of the Fowler Center at @ArkansasState in Jonesboro has begun. @SenateAgGOP

Life Skills for Youth, under the outstanding leadership of Larry Clark, is making a huge difference in the lives Little Rock’s young people by offering mentorship, skills development opportunities & helping meet nutrition needs. Appreciated getting an update on its efforts today. https://t.co/KBVSxbvlQn

It was terrific to spend time with @YMCA Youth Advocates Sabrina and Christian, as well as @hotspringsymca leaders, yesterday to discuss their legislative priorities in support of the childcare, nutrition, health, mentoring and education programs it offers. #ARinDC https://t.co/OBNIDmE87W

I trust local school nutrition professionals to know their students and what works in their schools to ensure the food they’re serving will be eaten, not thrown away. READ my latest column warning against USDA's unworkable revised nutrition standards.

https://t.co/aKnOJEReJa

Praying for their safety and for all those injured or impacted. Please follow all directions from local officials, exercise extra caution and support your family, friends and community in the days ahead.

The #AirDefender23 exercise is the largest deployment of air forces in NATO history: 10k participants from 25 nations including AR Air National Guard members.

I was proud to join German Chancellor Scholz in reaffirming our commitment to meet evolving global security challenges. https://t.co/MCn6Z7z9pI

The #AirDefender23 was a very impressive exercise I was proud to observe and the Paris Air Show provided an opportunity to build/maintain relationships with major aerospace industry entities making significant contributions to Arkansas's economy.

Read about my visits to both ⬇️

July is a great time to enjoy local parks and recreation opportunities right in your community or throughout our state. There are many to choose from that promote health and wellness, benefit the economy and serve to bring people together. Let's proudly celebrate these amenities. https://t.co/AeQNwRks74

Nutrition is critical to the ability of youth to thrive in and out of the classroom. I'm extremely pleased Arkansas, at Gov. @SarahHuckabee's direction, is utilizing the promising new tool my colleagues and I added to the toolbox for states to address food insecurity.

I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished to update and modernize federal nutrition assistance programs, including a summer meals program for hungry kids. READ my latest weekly column about taking steps to address food insecurity to help students thrive.

https://t.co/j6do9W8N6G

I welcomed AR School Nutrition Association leaders to my office to discuss strengthening meal programs for our kids. We’re grateful for all their efforts and I'm proud to work w/ them to champion policies that improve Natural State students’ access to nutritious food. #ARinDC https://t.co/oKZaaGyXyb

March is National Nutrition Month, so it was a pleasure to welcome Arkansas food security leaders to my office. I gave them an update on the #FarmBill and our work to strengthen child nutrition in schools. #ARinDC https://t.co/Wd4ooDPRIY

I'm proud of the incredible work of our EMS personnel in Arkansas. These heroes answer the call for help during emergencies and support the health and wellness of members of their communities. We’re working together to support access to this life-saving care. #ARinDC https://t.co/L5ZqVYN69G

It was a privilege to help modernize an outdated summer meals program, with the help of Natural State nutrition advocates, to ensure it serves more children in need. Arkansas's launch of Summer EBT applications by Gov. @SarahHuckabee Sanders is great news.
https://t.co/bs8f8L1gMU

Caring for our mental health is such an important practice to embrace. This month, we recognize that reality and commit to helping erase the stigma and promote care that leads to mental wellness. https://t.co/NrfyXqST5Q

The @SenateAgGOP #FarmBill framework supplies farmers with the tools they rely on while ensuring we promote new markets & research as well as protect nutrition programs & conservation practices. READ my latest weekly column about our farmer-focused plan.

https://t.co/gPALYe5ZWn

Congratulations to Amanda West of Monticello for being honored as a @NoKidHungry Summer Hunger Hero. We're proud that this Arkansan is being recognized for her tireless efforts to ensure families receive nutrition over the summer.

https://t.co/s304qjhV0H

It was great to hear how Arkansans are using federal nutrition programs to promote the purchase of locally grown produce at farmers markets. These wise, mutually beneficial initiatives enhance health and support farmers. #ARinDC https://t.co/WatMgV9UxL

Today I am excited to help celebrate thirty years of the Arkansas Children's Nutrition Center's efforts to expand access to innovative pediatric research and promote healthy development. The ACNC is a blessing we cannot and do not take for granted. https://t.co/Qqygzr5etI

This year the Arkansas Children’s Nutrition Center is celebrating 30 years of pediatric research and care. READ my latest weekly column highlighting its world-class efforts to promote healthy development for children here in our state and beyond. https://t.co/YhmF9hv8qs

The @ALWMedSchool is on the cusp of welcoming its first students and expanding health care access in Arkansas while emphasizing an innovative, whole health approach to wellness. I appreciated visiting with Dean Sharmila Makhjia and look forward to future opportunities we will have to partner on issues that impact the medical community and patients alike. #ARinDC
